app.name: International Rentals
app.description: Operations app for International Rentals staff.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: This app is for International Rentals staff.
login.staffIntro: Sign in with your email and password. You will set a PIN afterwards so you can reopen the app quickly.
login.managerIntro: We will email you a six-digit code. It is valid for a few minutes.
login.codeSent: If that address belongs to a manager account, a code is on its way. Enter it below.
login.failed: Those details did not work. Check them and try again.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.inactive: This account is no longer active. Ask the manager to reactivate it.
login.invalidCode: Enter the six digits from the email.

unlock.title: Enter your PIN
unlock.intro: Unlock the app to carry on.
unlock.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
unlock.setIntro: You will use this to reopen the app on this phone. Choose four to eight digits you will remember, and do not reuse a bank PIN.
unlock.mismatch: The two PINs are not the same.
unlock.tooShort: Use between four and eight digits.

home.title: Today
home.welcome: Signed in. The day's screens arrive with the booking work.
home.adminNote: Manager account — the movements sheet, fleet board and reports come next.
home.repNote: Rep account — availability, bookings and the pickup flow come next.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Applies everywhere in the app, on this and any other device.

availability.title: Availability
availability.invalidRange: The end date is before the start date.
availability.noneMatch: No cars match. Try widening the dates or filters.
availability.occupiedLabel: Occupied for part of this range

newBooking.title: New booking
newBooking.extrasHint: Free of charge. Lets the rep know what to have ready at pickup.
newBooking.priceNeedsCarAndDates: Choose a car and valid dates to see the price.

bookingDetail.title: Booking
bookingDetail.cancelConfirm: Cancel this booking? The guest will need a new booking if they still want the car.
bookingDetail.extendHint: The only change allowed once a rental is out. If the car is needed elsewhere on the new dates, a same-category swap is offered.
bookingDetail.extendCarFree: This car is free through the new date.
bookingDetail.extendCarTaken: This car is already booked on part of the new range.
bookingDetail.noAlternatives: No other car in this category is free for the whole range.
bookingDetail.keepSameCar: Keep this car (not available — checked above)

myBookings.title: My bookings
myBookings.searchPlaceholder: Guest name, plate, ref or date

today.title: Today
today.handedOver: €{amount} handed over. The manager confirms it at his end.

damage.zoneHint: Pick the area, or tap the drawing.
damage.noteHint: Optional — what it is and how big.
damage.surfaceHint: Tap the drawing where the damage is, or use the form below.
damage.surfaceHintReadOnly: Damage already recorded on this car.
damage.carriedTitle: Already on the car at pickup

handover.shortfallNotice: {n}/8 less than at pickup. This is recorded and goes to the manager — do not price it and do not collect for it.

pickup.title: Pickup
pickup.driversIntro: Type each driver's licence details. Additional drivers are free of charge.
pickup.additionalFree: Free of charge. Their licence is checked in exactly the same way.
pickup.dobHint: Used for the age check against this car's category.
pickup.licenceCountryHint: Two or three letters, e.g. GR or GBR.
pickup.licencePhotoPending: Photographs of the licence are not captured yet — they arrive with the agreement. The details typed above are what the check uses, and they are enough to hand the car over.
pickup.noDrivers: No driver has been recorded yet. Add the main driver first.
pickup.blockedBody: One of the rules above is not met. There is no way past this from here, and it must not be worked around.
pickup.overrideAsk: Only the manager can allow it. Call him with booking {ref} and the reason shown above; he lifts it from his own screen.
pickup.overrideRecorded: The manager has allowed this pickup despite the check above. The override is on the record.
pickup.confirmHint: Confirming hands the car over and moves this booking to Out. After that only an extension is possible.
pickup.alreadyOut: This car has already been handed over.
pickup.notPickable: This booking is not open for pickup.

returnFlow.title: Return
returnFlow.sameToSame: The car goes out and comes back at the same level. Read the gauge as it is now.
returnFlow.damageIntro: Damage already on the car at pickup is shown greyed out and cannot be changed here. Add anything new.
returnFlow.damageNotPriced: Record what you can see and nothing more. New damage goes to the manager, who decides what it costs. Do not price it, do not argue it and do not take money for it.
returnFlow.willFlagFuel: The manager will be sent the {n}/8 shortfall to settle.
returnFlow.willFlagDamage: The manager will be sent {n, plural, one {# new mark} other {# new marks}} to settle.
returnFlow.confirmHint: Confirming closes the rental. The remaining days go back into availability straight away, and the price does not change — an early return earns no refund.
returnFlow.alreadyReturned: This rental has already been returned.
returnFlow.notReturnable: This booking is not out, so there is nothing to return.

movements.title: Movements sheet
movements.subtitle: Every pickup and return due today, across every hotel, in time order.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.searchPlaceholder: Guest, plate, ref, hotel, rep or date
bookings.priceHint: The only way a booking's price is amended. Every change is logged.

cars.title: Car management
cars.noModels: No models exist yet. Add at least one category and model before adding cars.
cars.archived: {n, plural, one {# archived car} other {# archived cars}}
cars.notesHint: Visible to the manager only. Never shown to a rep.
cars.deleteConfirm: Delete this car permanently? This cannot be undone. Prefer Archive unless this was a data-entry mistake.

categories.title: Categories & models
categories.empty: No categories yet. Add the 8 categories the client uses (A–H).

models.tankLitresHint: Needed for the fuel policy at pickup and return.

blocks.title: Blocked dates
blocks.screenHint: Service, repair or a write-off. A rep sees this exactly like another rep's booking — no reason, ever.
blocks.empty: No blocks in the last or next year.
blocks.reasonHint: Manager-only. Never shown to a rep.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.noCategories: No categories exist yet. Add categories before setting prices.
pricing.noPeriods: No pricing periods yet. Add one to start entering totals.
pricing.deletePeriodConfirm: Delete this pricing period and every total in it? This cannot be undone. Bookings already priced from it keep their stored total.
pricing.bulkPasteHint: One line per category: the category code, then 8 numbers — the totals for 1 to 7 days, then the extra-day rate. Tab, comma or semicolon separated — paste straight out of a spreadsheet.
pricing.bulkPasteLineError: Line {line} could not be read. Check the category code and that there are exactly 8 numbers.
pricing.previewHint: Shows what a sample rental would actually cost, using this screen's saved prices — the same calculation a booking uses.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Everything non-standard in the business lands here. The rep records the evidence; you decide the amount and close it.
exceptions.emptyOpen: Nothing open. Everything raised has been dealt with.
exceptions.fuelJudgement: Nothing has been charged for this. The app records the shortfall and leaves the amount to you.
exceptions.resolveHint: Set what it costs and say what was decided. This is the only place either is set, and the change is logged.
exceptions.chargeHint: Leave blank for nothing to charge. Blank and €0.00 are recorded differently.
exceptions.resolutionHint: Kept on the record. Reps never see it.

cookies.body: This app uses cookies that keep you signed in, remember your language and protect forms from abuse. There is no advertising or analytics cookie.

privacy.intro: This is an internal application used by International Rentals staff to run vehicle rentals. It holds data about staff who use it and about guests who rent a vehicle.
privacy.staff: For each member of staff we store a name, an email address, a phone number, a language preference, the hotel or hotels they cover, and a hashed PIN used to reopen the app. Sign-in attempts and administrative actions are logged so that account misuse can be investigated.
privacy.guest: For each rental we store the guest's name, phone number, date of birth, hotel and room number, an optional email address used only to send a copy of the agreement, and each driver's licence details together with photographs of the licence.
privacy.lawful: Rental and driver data is held to perform the rental contract and to meet the legal requirement to check that a driver is licensed and eligible to drive the vehicle. Staff data is held to operate the system and to keep it secure.
privacy.retention: Photographs of driving licences are deleted automatically after a period set by the company, twenty-four months after the rental ends by default. The booking record, the signed agreement and the typed licence number are kept for longer, as accounting and insurance obligations require. Every deletion is logged.
privacy.security: Licence photographs are held in private storage and can only be reached through short-lived links issued to a member of staff who is entitled to that booking. All access is over HTTPS. Staff can only see the bookings they created or those belonging to a hotel they cover.
privacy.rights: You can ask for a copy of the personal data held about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted where there is no legal obligation to keep it. Contact the company using the details on the rental agreement.
privacy.contact: Company registered details and a data contact address are to be confirmed and will appear here before launch.

terms.scope: This application is provided to named members of International Rentals staff for the purpose of managing vehicle rentals. It is not a public service and no public booking is possible through it.
terms.accounts: Accounts are created by the manager. Sign-in details and the device PIN are personal and must not be shared. A rep account is bound to a single device; signing in elsewhere ends the previous binding.
terms.use: Staff may access only the bookings they are entitled to see, and may not attempt to reach data belonging to another rep or hotel. Prices are set by the company and may not be altered, discounted or negotiated.
terms.data: Guest and licence data may be used only to complete the rental in hand. It must not be copied, photographed, shared or kept outside this application.
terms.availability: The application requires an internet connection. The company does not guarantee uninterrupted availability, and paper fallback procedures remain in force during the pilot.
terms.changes: These terms will be finalised alongside the rental agreement terms before launch.
